page.topic: Decarbonization and asset value for commercial real estate
target_prompts: How can commercial real estate owners cut building emissions while protecting asset value?
fan_out: How much of global emissions come from buildings and why does it matter for asset value?
Which measures (energy management, BMS, renewables, retrofits) cut building emissions most?
How does decarbonization affect stranded-asset risk, GRESB scores and valuations?
What savings and paybacks have real portfolios achieved?
Where should a portfolio owner start (assessment, roadmap)?

criteria.rationale: Opening addresses the portfolio owner's goals but only vaguely ('integrated digital solutions'); slogan H1, descriptive title; no section answers or summary.
Brand voice ('Your mission... Ours is...'), hype and slogans; no limitations.
No architecture or component roles; only '6,000+ data points' parameter, hidden.
Audience (portfolio managers) named; no definition, no specific trigger; outcome is a 'we can help you' promise.
Slogan headings, label-only tab list, 'our/you' copy; key customer results only in hidden tabs; testimonial blocks have names but no quote text.
Statistics unsourced (37%), no standards by number, testimonial names without quotes, case metrics without method, no owner.
Several quantified outcomes (Blackstone, Citycon, Aspiria), one tied to EcoStruxure, persona KPIs; no baseline or method (c3 fail -> <= 3).
Seed answered loosely via customer examples and retrofit mention; fan-outs (which measures, valuation link, where to start) not given dedicated answers; buyer facts thin.
Applications with context (mall, office, flexible fit-out) and retrofits mentioned; no scope boundaries or fit guidance.
Stranded-asset risk stated up top and buildings' 37% emissions share quantified, but unsourced (c3 fail -> <= 3).
Named CRE references with results and context, but mostly hidden tabs; testimonial blocks lack quote text; no independent validation of claims.
No phases, deliverables, delivery model or timeline.
Awareness-level overview with insight links for portfolio owners; descriptive asset CTAs (executive summary, e-guide).

disclaimer: Citation-readiness of content only; actual AI citation also depends on retrieval, off-site consensus and technical access.
